column1: # Vocabulary allowed INSIDE definitions and examples but not taught as cards.
# The deck's definitions were originally restricted to the A2 word list. That
# restriction produced definitions that were gate-legal but ambiguous — in
# ~20 synonym pairs both definitions fitted both words, so the definition->word
# card had two right answers. The review pass lifted the restriction where a
# non-A2 word buys real distinctness: sąnarys instead of "kūno vieta, kur ranka
# sukasi", rankovė instead of "be rankų", kruopos instead of "iš pieno".
# Every word here is a deliberate, single, well-chosen content word inside an
# otherwise A2 definition. None of them gets a card; the learner meets them
# only as supporting vocabulary. Every form listed is hunspell lt_LT verified
# (the gate's SPELL check runs over the same text).
# Format: lemma <TAB> space-separated forms used in the deck.
# verify_defs.py folds this into the allowed-vocabulary set.
# added by the final verification pass
# support words used inside the batch31 definitions
# inflected support forms the batch31 gate flagged
# `kuris` is used in 406 definitions ("Žmogus, kuris…", "Vieta, kurioje…") but
# was never on the allowed list: those strings passed the A2 check only because
# they collide with inflections of the VERB `kurti` ("to create") in
# forms_cache.json. `kuriais` does not collide, which is how the hole surfaced.
# Full paradigm from the en-Wiktionary table for `kuris` (pron), hunspell
# lt_LT verified; `kuriom` rejected by hunspell and dropped.

column2: kuri kuria kuriai kuriais kuriam kuriame kurias kurie kuriems kurio kurioje kuriomis kurioms kurios kuriose kuris kuriuo kuriuos kuriuose kurią kurių kurį
